objective: Preallocate hybrid-search RRF result vectors from the known score map size before sorting and limiting.

tasks.title: Preallocate hybrid RRF result buffer
tasks.result: Hybrid search now preallocates the RRF result vector from rrf_scores.len() before moving score entries into the sortable result buffer.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The change preserves RRF scoring, HashMap iteration semantics, select_nth_unstable_by limiting, and final RRF score sort order.
